notes:
**Windows** — run `ruze_0.0.13_x64-setup.exe`.
**Linux** — `flatpak install ruze-0.0.13.flatpak`, then `flatpak run com.ruze.chat`.
**Android** — sideload `ruze-0.0.13.apk`. arm64 devices, Android 8.0 or newer.

---

### Added

- **Ruze tells you when there is a new Ruze.** A new section in settings shows
  the version you are running, what changed in it and in every release before
  it, and whether there is a newer one. Checking happens on launch and every
  few hours, and can be turned off; installing is never automatic.

  How you get an update depends on where you are running, and the app says
  which rather than pretending they are the same. Windows downloads the
  installer. Linux is a Flatpak — nothing the app does can replace a read-only
  sandbox, so it hands you the `flatpak install` line. Android downloads the
  APK and gives it to the system package installer, which will only accept a
  build signed with the same key as the one you already have.

- **A beta channel.** One switch, and this device follows releases as they are
  cut rather than waiting for them to be final. Turning it back off means
  waiting for stable to catch up — an update never goes backwards, so you are
  never downgraded into a version you have already passed.
